Subject: Clarification on the Weekly Progress Report Submission Process

Dear Team,

I hope this message finds you well. 

To ensure we maintain clear communication and adhere to our established processes, I would like to provide a brief clarification regarding the weekly progress report submission. 

Each Friday by 5 PM, please submit your completed progress reports via the designated portal. It is crucial that all team members submit their reports in a timely manner to facilitate the weekly review meetings scheduled for Monday mornings. 

If you have any questions or need further guidance on completing the reports, please feel free to reach out. Your feedback and any queries are highly appreciated as they help us improve our processes and ensure smooth operations.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,

[Your Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Your Contact Information]  
[Company Name]
